hook.text: No one outside Meta knows exactly how the Facebook algorithm works. The code that shapes billions of minds is secret.

buildup.text: Researchers can't study what they can't see. Platforms claim algorithms are trade secrets and refuse audits.

discovery.text: The EU's Digital Services Act requires platforms to explain algorithmic decisions. The first major transparency law.

twist.text: Platforms argue transparency enables gaming. Reveal the algorithm and people exploit it. Secrecy is safety, they say.

climax.text: The tension is real: full transparency invites manipulation but secrecy enables unchecked power. No easy answer exists.

punchline.text: You can't regulate what you can't see.

quiz.question: What does the EU's Digital Services Act require from platforms?
